nodes.speaker: Projectionist
nodes.text: Welcome to the Theater! Take a seat. The show is always running here.

nodes.speaker: Projectionist
text: The GIF Gallery is a media collection app. Upload, organize, and share your favorite GIFs and images.
It's got tagging, search, and a slick viewing mode. Think of it as your personal media library.

nodes.speaker: Projectionist
nodes.text: The portal to the GIF Gallery is on the right. This one's open to everyone — no ticket needed.

nodes.speaker: Projectionist
nodes.text: Check out the posters on the walls — classic selections. The portal is on the right when you're ready for the real show.

nodes.speaker: Projectionist
nodes.text: Press ESC to head back outside. Enjoy the show!
